Kerala CM Denies Dispute Over Sabarimala Arrangements

Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has stated there is no dispute with the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) regarding the arrangements for Sabarimala. This statement was also echoed by VD Satheesan.
